usedFor: HelloLeads CRM captures the lead and Sangam CRM takes it on, so “New Lead Added” runs “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Added” in HelloLeads CRM, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: The action updates by ID, email or phone, so a repeat lead need not create a duplicate.

watchOut: “New Lead Added” in HelloLeads CRM is polling, so leads reach Sangam CRM after a scheduled check.
